reviews.x: Product reviews on Amazon are something I always rely upon to make my purchase decision. Before buying this brand of floss, which was first time for my family (We usually buy Oral-B Glide floss at Costco), the straight 5-star reviews caught my attention so I thought this must be really good stuff. But as it turned out, this is nothing near the dental floss we expected - the line is too thin to hold on to; there is no waxing so moving in and out of the teeth gap is frustrating, not to mention the

I put them in my wallet along side "survival cards" so that I can use the floss for many different application such as, fishing line, suture material, cordage for lashing, to use as improvised weapon or cutting material. Oh and did I mention that floss works great for getting things out from between your teeth :) The cards are so convenient and small that they fit just about anywhere and I truly go no place without one. reviews.t: These are great!
reviews.x: I'm all about being able to fit essentials into my wallet.  I have had several occasions where I desperately need floss, and now I won't have to worry about that anymore!  They each contain 12 yards, and easily fit in a credit card slot of your wallet.  I was worried about the thickness, but it is just as thin as a regular credit card.  It says they are "Ultra light waxed" which I would agree with, because you can't really tell that it's waxed, but it helps keep the floss from fraying.

reviews.t: Excellent product for your dental hygiene
reviews.x: This is the best dental floss ever. I was at a friend's house and needed flossing, she gave me a sample of this floss and I was so impress with the results that  I came home and searched the internet for it. It's very fine so you are able to get in between every tooth with comfort. The regular drug store floss was always getting ripped apart by the tights spaces between my teeth but not this. I got a really good, comfortable clean from it and it's easy to put in your purse along side your credit

reviews.t: I love these things
reviews.x: I stocked up on these when I went through Basic training in San Diego in 07, finally on my last card. Shows how much I use them, But I have always had one in my wallet for the past 7 years. It is always nice to have some floss when you are out and about and you never know when you are going to be eating and something gets painfully jammed between your teeth.  Plus if your into survival/prepping, you always have some string on you with these, great for camping, first aid kits, or random handouts

reviews.t: I love FLOSSCARD! I had a similar product that I ...
reviews.x: I love FLOSSCARD!  I had a similar product that I got from a company as a giveaway years ago.  A friend needed some dental floss, so I gave her my card.  She was saying her son-in-law is always asking her for dental floss, so I sent her a 10-pack of FLOSSCARDs and then ordered another 10-pack for myself.  They fit perfectly in a wallet or a side pocket of a bag.  You never know when you might need a little dental floss, and the FLOSSCARD is the perfect solution when you just got to get at someth

reviews.t: Breaks in your mouth- THIN AND WEAK
reviews.x: Worst floss ever...very weak and consistently breaks in between my teeth. Its also much thinner than regular floss so it hurts your fingers. I guess if you have reasonably wide spaces this might work, but I have three crowns with very tight spaces between teeth and this breaks every time

reviews.t: Wallet-sized, strong, does the intended job nicely.  Highly recommend!
reviews.x: For some reason lately, I'm constantly getting food caught in my back teeth when I eat meat, certain vegetables, etc.  I usually keep floss in my car and at the office, but there are times when I don't have it readily available.  If I don't take care of the issue right away, my gums get really sore and swollen and painful for the next day or two.  I looked for something that would fit in my wallet.  Despite a couple of reviews saying this floss was weak and would break easily, I gave it a try.

reviews.t: perfect product.
reviews.x: Years ago, my dentist gave me two flosscards with his name on it and I loved them so much that I barely let myself use them. I was thrilled to see that I could buy them directly on my own. I am like the Princess and the Pea about my teeth; I can barely think about anything else if I have food caught between them. Believe me, I will go nowhere without a flosscard in my wallet. They really are as thin as a credit card and So Much More Useful.

reviews.t: As an emergency "just ate a steak at a restaurant and need floss immediately" kind of floss it is brilliant and worth fi
reviews.x: Been using these for ten plus years.  As an emergency "just ate a steak at a restaurant and need floss immediately" kind of floss it is brilliant and worth five stars.  However, a daily, before bed in front of the mirror floss, it is not.  The floss is really crummy.  It is thin, not waxed, and if you have tight teeth like me it will go in and won't come out without fraying.  It does serve it's purpose however.

reviews.t: A floss to help you always be prepared
reviews.x: I am always forgetting dental floss whenever I travel and this product has helped me out more than a few times. It is also great for those times when you need to floss after a meal out and a tooth pick won't do. It is a bit pricy for the amount of floss you get only 12 yards. However, it is always handy and you don't have to go searching around in the bottom of your purse for it as it fits perfectly in a wallet slot.

reviews.t: Fantastic Product
reviews.x: Best floss I've ever used, thin and strong. The card is so convent. I have receding gums and now I can floss were I really need too. I never liked flossing before; it would get caught between my teeth. It's easy being in a slim card to take it with you everywhere. Thanks so much for your ingenuity.

reviews.t: Super convenient. Great idea.
reviews.x: Love these. I always have one in my wallet. When I take it out to use it, others ask where I got it. It’s nice to have on hand when you need to get something unstick from between your teeth or just because you need a piece of string for something.

reviews.t: Great way to have floss on the go!
reviews.x: This is by far the best way to carry floss away from home. These little cards fit easily in a wallet are are the same size as a credit card. Instead of carrying a bulky dispenser, you have 36 feet of floss close at hand. I also keep one in the console of my truck (for daily use) and stuck one in my first aid kit (as a spare or to use for an emergency situation). If you backpack or have a Bug out Bag, this is one of those items that you cannot do without. They fit perfect in an Altoids tin if you

reviews.t: These are awesome!!
reviews.x: I used to get these from a friend who worked in a dental office and I thought they were fantastic. About the size of a credit card and easily fit in my wallet. They're great when you're at a restaurant or somewhere on the go where you wouldn't normally carry dental floss. Unfortunatey, my friend moved away but I luckily was able to find them on Amazon. For me, there's nothing worse than having something stuck between my teeth all day that I can't get out.  I highly recommend this product... tota

reviews.t: Perfectly portable and one seems to last forever!
reviews.x: These Flosscards are awesome! I first received one from a dentist I used to go to, and when that ran out (after what seemed like a REALLY long time for such a small footprint package!), I went in search of how to get some for myself (yay Amazon!). It's literally no bigger than a credit card, so keep one in my wallet at all times, and I'm never in that terrible position of being around other people with food in my teeth!! Will definitely keep coming back for more of these!!

reviews.t: Wouldn’t recommend if you have had braces or have teeth that are close together.
reviews.x: I love the idea of having a floss card. I was so excited to get them. I do not like it. It says that they are lightly waxed but feels like they are not at all. It feels uncomfortable to try to get in between your teeth. I have had braces and my teeth are close together and I cannot get it though my teeth. It gets stuck and always breaks. My mother in the other hand LOVES it. She has never has braces and her teeth aren’t quite as close together.

reviews.t: No more toothpicks!
reviews.x: I agree, these would be better if they were waxed, but for the convenience these offer I cannot complain.  The few times I've truly NEEDED these, they saved my sanity.  I keep a card in my wallet and it's come in handy a couple of times.  I'm still working on my first card since I only need it for emergencies, so for the price these are great.  They will last me a few years at the least and I couldn't go back to not having these with me.

reviews.t: This is ingenious.
reviews.x: Wild horses couldn't get my husband or son to use dental floss until a friend gave my husband a Flosscard. He keeps it in his wallet and we all use it now if we are out for a meal. But alas our card ran out and believe it or not, my husband asked for a new supply for his birthday! I ordered the 20-pack with the hope he will share when he opens his present.  I am so happy we discovered Flosscard and so is our dental hygienist.

reviews.t: Very nice convenient product.
reviews.x: I originally got a few of these from my periodontist and loved them so much I had to order some for myself.  They are great to keep in your wallet so you always have some floss with you.  My coworkers thought it was odd the first time they saw me pull out my floss card, but now they ask me for a piece of floss a few times a week.  This is a great product for people who like to take good care of their teeth and gums.

reviews.t: BE READY TO FLOSS ON THE GO
reviews.x: I was given one of these years ago as a freebie from my dentist and have been looking for them ever since.  They are PERFECT!  No more waiting until you get home to deal with whatever is caught in your teeth.  The card fits exactly in the credit card slot in a wallet so you always have floss handy...corn on the cob, popcorn, and berries HERE I COME

reviews.t: The floss part is awful.
reviews.x: If you want strong string in a flat carrying case, this is your product. But if you want to pull this through your teeth I think you will be disappointed. This stuff splits and strips apart, its becomes raw thread between your teeth. I bought these thinking I might hand them out to friends. No. Do not give this product to friends.

reviews.t: Floss when you need it!  Great product.
reviews.x: This is such a great idea.  I didn't know this product existed until a few days ago when I needed some convenient floss and decided to see if any products existed!  I was hoping not because I thought I could design and market it!  But, it already existed!  I've got my first pack in hand and just love it.  I highly recommend it.

reviews.t: Floss when you need it!  Great product.
reviews.x: This is such a great idea.  I didn't know this product existed until a few days ago when I needed some convenient floss and decided to see if any products existed!  I was hoping not because I thought I could design and market it!  But, it already existed!  I've got my first pack in hand and just love it.  I highly recommend it.

reviews.t: Yay for on-the-go FLOSS!
reviews.x: This is a great deal! Floss doesn't break off like some other cheap flosses I have tried. Nice and slim-just like a credit card. I wish they could figure out a way to put a mirror on it, like another product I reviewed. But that floss item was too bulky, so win some, lose some. But yeah, this is a great deal. -ERIN

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the card's wallet-sized, credit-card form factor as highly convenient for carrying floss on the go.
Many reviewers find the floss thin and strong and effective at cleaning between teeth, with some calling it the best floss they've used.
Several reviewers describe it as ideal for emergency or on-the-go use after meals rather than as a daily flossing solution.
Some reviewers report the floss is thin and weak, breaking between teeth, especially with tight spaces or crowns.
A few reviewers note the product is pricey for the small amount of floss (12 yards) provided.
